prompt: Investiga cómo se relacionan los 4 plugins entre sí: stepwise-core, stepwise-git, stepwise-web, stepwise-research. ¿Comparten código? ¿Hay dependencias cruzadas?

assertions.text: Mentions all 4 plugins by name: stepwise-core, stepwise-git, stepwise-web, stepwise-research
Identifies at least one cross-plugin dependency: research-codebase skill (core) references web-search-researcher agent (web plugin)
References .claude-plugin/marketplace.json as the mechanism that groups the 4 plugins into a single marketplace
Research document has YAML frontmatter (--- delimited) with at least date and git_commit fields
Document is saved to thoughts/shared/research/ directory
